_doc: The front-desk mode (repo/handover/HANDOVER.md). Every switch is off until Justin says it in the lead's chat. Names of things only: no key, table id or address is in this file.

orders._doc: An order from Justin becomes one row in the Requests table of his Notion Command Center. The table's id is in context/owner.md as NOTION_REQUESTS_TABLE.

_crm_writer_doc: sales-crm (this bot writes the CRM) or operator (campaign.json crm.writer is none and the day file is handed to the Operator).

capture._doc: One line per agent session to the single brain's activity folder. Needs the path from NEEDS-JUSTIN A9.

events_first._doc: Once the Reply webhook is seen firing on two different days, Reply check runs once a day as the catch-up. Pipeline sweep stays twice a day.
